apiGaps.reason: not registered in ForgeFSE Lua (absent from forge_quest_bindings.txt)
ForgeFSE has no predicate-fail hook in the binding lists; the Lua function exists but nothing in the host is known to invoke it

uncertainties: What makes the barrel predicate fail (destruction / removal of the thing) is not visible in these decompiles; only the OnPredicateFail side effects are.
ForgeFSE has no known OnPredicateFail hook, so BarrelBrokenInstantaneous/Persistent/Pos are never set at runtime unless the host adds one.
IsXbox is unbound; the Lua always takes the PC text branch (retail PC behaviour), the Xbox key is preserved as a constant.
The idle loop after the instruction is retail behaviour: the barrel script does nothing else until termination.

missingOn: terminate (retail returns without dismissing the box)

coupling: Quest-level thread WatchBarrels (0x00DBE890, not part of this entity) collects all things named NOVI_Barrel, clears BarrelBrokenInstantaneous each time it sees it set and counts breaks: first break -> AddBadDeed(PARENT, 0); break number (count-1) -> AddItemToContainer(NOVI_Barrel thing, OBJECT_GOLD_1); breaks beyond (count-4) -> CreateCreature(CREATURE_OAKVALE_STAG_BEETLE at BarrelBrokenPos, script NOVI_CreatedBeetle) + EntitySetMaxHealth(2.0, true). It stops when AttackOver is set.
NOVI_BarrelMan reads BarrelBrokenPersistent for his LETDOWN_BROKEN / LETDOWN_NOT_BROKE line.
InstructionGiven_Barrels is shared by all barrels: the first one the hero approaches shows the instruction, the rest skip it.
